thread:
Maya: FYI weekly numbers — webinar registrants up 42% after the launch thread, but demo requests are flat. dashboard shows a fall in webinar->trial conversion. thoughts?
Ravi: saw the spike. could be noise from the social post bundle. did we change attribution window for the new report?
Clara: attribution still last-touch 7d. iirc we switched the report to 7d from 30d last quarter for readability. that can make fast-touch channels look better and slow channels worse.
Jules: agreed. last-touch penalizes webinars where people read a launch post first then convert later. we should compare last vs first touch and a 30d window.
Tariq (Analytics): running a quick cohort compare now. sending query snippet:```-- compare last vs first touch conversion
SELECT touch_type, count(distinct user_id) as users, SUM(converted) as conv
FROM marketing.attribution
WHERE event_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND CURRENT_DATE()
GROUP BY touch_type;```
Lina (SalesOps): small ask — can analytics flag which leads came from webinar yesterday? our SDRs did outreach and flagged two duplicates already. worried about double outreach.
dashbot: dashboard "Marketing Weekly KPI" updated by Tariq :bar_chart:
Tariq (Analytics): quick take: first-touch 30d shows webinar-attributed trial growth of +12% vs last-touch 7d which shows -6%. looks like windowing is the issue. i'm exporting the cohort with contact ids.
Maya: ok action items: (1) include a small table in the weekly deck showing last vs first touch and 7d vs 30d for webinars, (2) ask comms to annotate the deck with explanation, (3) salesops to hold outreach cadence for flagged leads until we confirm dedupe.
Clara: also propose a quick AB: keep last-touch for the headline metric but add a stability metric (30d first-touch) so execs get both views. saves us from changing attribution mid-quarter.
Jules: on messaging iteration — noticed comments that the launch post CTA is weird for webinar attendees (asks for product eval vs scheduling). can Marketing Ops run a 2-line variant and measure CTR to register?
Maya: yes please. A/B variant for post copy, small CTA test. put results in the same KPI slide.
Tariq (Analytics): exported cohort CSV to https://bigquery.cloud.redwood/marketing/exports/att-cohort-193310.csv. also flagged 78 potential duplicates (same email, different utm variants). will normalize utm_campaign values and re-run dedupe.
Lina (SalesOps): thanks. i'll pause outreach for the flagged list and notify SDR team leads.
Maya: timeline — can we have the deck table and CTA test setup before tomorrow's KPI huddle?
Ravi: will update the dashboard with a comparison viz by EOD and add an annotation about attribution windows.
Clara: I'll draft the comms blurb explaining why metrics differ and include the CTA test plan.
Maya: great. post-mortem? not necessary but assign follow-ups in Asana. thanks everyone. :sparkles:
